title: Compaction Spire
pages: Craft the controller with sealed steel plate, copper and iron blocks, and obsidian. Place obsidian below it and a redstone block above it. Put copper blocks directly east and west of it and two blocks out to the north and south (leaving the north and south faces open), and iron blocks at all four upper diagonal corners. One level higher, place pistons on the four horizontal sides around the empty center; cap the center one more level up with an iron block. The piston crown and cap complete the vertical compression frame. Use the Structure Projector to build it layer by layer.

Right-click the formed controller with enough material for two batches of its own loaded arcana_industry:compaction recipe. The spire loads exactly twice that recipe's input count into its stock buffer and refuses new feed while a batch is buffered or output is waiting. After the 40-tick cycle, use an empty hand to collect both outputs. It stops if any frame block, crown piston, compression cap, or base is missing.

Automation: hoppers or pipes feed the open north face (any face defaults to input), which buffers stock. Every 40 ticks the formed spire consumes two batches of the loaded recipe at once and stores both outputs in its product buffer; a single batch waits until the second arrives. Sneak-use the south face with an empty hand to switch it to output and pull products with a hopper or pipe; the bottom face is output by default but is covered by obsidian. An empty hand collects the buffer, and a broken frame pauses processing without losing stock.

Compaction recipes are distinct from the Press's pressing recipes: four redstone compact into one compacted electrode, two gravel into flint, one clay ball into a brick, nine bone meal into a bone block and four snowballs into packed ice. One electrode is required in the t2 Leaching Vat craft and two more in the Electrolyzer craft alongside purified salts. It needs no FE. JEI lists its compaction recipes under the Compaction Spire catalyst, with the doubled input and two separate output stacks shown.

Fifteen more batches round the Spire out to twenty: sand into sandstone, red sand into red sandstone, quartz into quartz block, prismarine shards into prismarine and prismarine crystals into sea lantern, magma cream into magma block and nine packed ice into one blue ice, nine slime balls into a slime block, glowstone dust into glowstone, nine nether wart into a nether wart block, honeycomb into honeycomb block, three rabbit hides into one leather (one fewer than the crafting grid needs), nine gold or iron nuggets back into an ingot, and nine dried kelp into a dried kelp block. Packed ice chains from the snowball batch above it into blue ice at the vanilla crafting ratio; the Spire takes eighteen packed ice for its doubled batch.
Prismarine crystals compact five to one sea lantern (ten crystals for the spire's doubled batch). Rinsing, resonating and scoring recover no more than five crystals per lantern.
